sketch: M present 6-8h; M's mechanism lowers fever within 2h; no other medicine; fever would not break alone; fever broke => M caused it.
statements: A patient has a fever caused by a worsening infection.
Medicine M blocks the body's fever signal, which always brings the fever down within two hours.
The patient receives a dose of medicine M at 6 o'clock.
The patient takes no other medicine that day.
A worsening infection does not break on its own within two hours.
At 8 o'clock the patient's fever is gone.
Determine whether medicine M caused the fever to break.
target: Medicine M caused the fever to break.

trace.concl: The dose of M was acting in the patient's body between 6 and 8 o'clock.
